'''Lioko''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. In c. [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Lioko's grandmother [[Vilia Calimondra]] ordered her grandchildren to attack the [[Bactranate|territories]] of the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]], and Lioko captured a proportion of Bactra's holdings. After [[Odion]] recovered the [[Helm of Ieldis]] and attempted to destroy [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by driving all life into a homicidal frenzy, Lioko contributed warships to an allied armada assembled by Vilia to stop Odion's nihilistic ambitions from succeeding.
